name: nx-codex
description: Security-first Siemens NX control, bounded assembly/drafting inspection, and a protected-copy test drawing through a typed local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Detect, plan, preflight, and verify safe Siemens NX work.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a local Siemens NX session through a per-user Named Pipe, exact-version typed tools, read-only assembly/drafting/CAE/CAM active-license detection, bounded fail-closed assembly hierarchy and drafting sheet/view inspection, one fixed protected-copy test-sheet/base-view transaction, policy-restricted files, NX undo transactions, modeling preflight, and joint measurement, feature-tree, and screenshot verification.
defaultPrompt: Detect assembly, drafting, CAE, and CAM capability without modifying NX.
Read a bounded assembly hierarchy only when an assembly license is already active, without loading or modifying components.
Read bounded drawing-sheet and drafting-view metadata only when a drafting license is already active, without opening, updating, or modifying drawings.
Create one fixed A4 test sheet and base view only in an exact saved and empty protected copy, verify NX's actual returned metadata, and never save automatically.
Report the exact NXOpen adapter and compatibility contract without modifying NX.
Plan and preflight a block, execute it, then jointly verify it without saving.
